---
title: Home
body-classes: home-page
page-layout: full
listing:
  - id: home-flagship-projects
    contents:
      - proyectos/*.qmd
      - "!proyectos/index.qmd"
    template: includes/home-projects.ejs.md
    include:
      access: public
      tier: flagship
    sort: "year desc"
  - id: home-flagship-writing
    contents:
      - posts/*.qmd
      - "!posts/index.qmd"
    template: includes/home-writing.ejs.md
    include:
      access: public
      tier: flagship
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: home-flagship-cursos
    contents:
      - cursos/*.qmd
      - "!cursos/index.qmd"
    template: includes/home-writing.ejs.md
    template-params:
      empty_message: No hay cursos destacados todavía.
    include:
      access: public
      tier: flagship
    sort: "date desc"
---
